description: The Open Standard for Generative UI
summary: OpenUI lets you declare a component library, auto-generates the system prompt from it, and streams back a compact structured language (up to 67% fewer tokens than JSON) that a renderer parses progressively in React, Vue, Svelte, or Angular. That "constrain the model's output space by what you allow, then render as tokens arrive" pattern is exactly the seam I want between PenguPool's agent sessions and whatever surface displays their output, and it would save me hand-rolling schema-to-prompt glue for Proreerfolio's résumé and job-fit views. The framework-agnostic lang-core package is the kind of small, swappable dependency I actually want in my stack rather than another full framework commitment.
